title: Tow Truck
synopsis: In Albuquerque, a tow truck driver picks up a seemingly ordinary 1956 Chevrolet Impala, only to discover that the car is an intergalactic robot on the run. An unexpected encounter turns an ordinary job into a chaotic sci-fi adventure.
